au-f2005l03523.summary: ADR 83/00 sets limits on external noise generated by road motor vehicles, to limit traffic's contribution to community noise. It applies to L-, M- and N-category vehicles (not trailers) from dates in its applicability table, and deems UN Regulations 51, 41, 63 and 9 (specified series of amendments) equivalent.
au-f2005l03523._why: Scope cl.1 and alternative standards cl.6.1-6.4; trailers not applicable; text is noise only (no emissions or horn content)

au-f2005l03907._why: Scope: direction indicator devices; cl.7.1 accepts UN R6

au-f2005l03908._why: Scope cl.2 glazing performance; cl.8.4 UN R43 equivalent; trailers N/A in applicability table

au-f2005l03990._why: Applicability table: only MA passenger cars (from 1 Jan 2000); all other categories N/A; cl.6.1 UN R94 01 series equivalent

au-f2005l03991._why: Scope cl.1 installation of lamps on non-L-group vehicles; cl.11.1 UN R48 00-06 series equivalent

au-f2005l04012._why: Scope: installation of lighting on L-group vehicles; cl.12 accepts UN R53 and R74

au-f2006l01279.summary: ADR 28/01 defines limits on external noise generated by motor vehicles to limit traffic's contribution to community noise, with Annex A measurement methods and instruments. It applies to LE, M and N category vehicles from dates in its table; vehicles complying with ADR 83/00 need not comply. UN R51/01 or 51/02 is deemed equivalent.

au-f2006l01280.summary: ADR 30/01 prescribes smoke emission requirements for diesel-fuelled vehicles to reduce air pollution. It applies to M and N category vehicles with diesel engines from 2002/2003, with exclusions for light vehicles meeting ADR 79/04 or later, and deems UN ECE Regulation 24 technical requirements equivalent.
au-f2006l01280._why: Scope cl.1.1, applicability cl.2.1-2.5, alternative standards cl.6.1 (old summary ended with '...'). Note text says compilation of ADR 79/05, likely a compiler header error

au-f2006l01362._why: Appendix A is UN R11 (04 series); cl.6.1 deems R11 02-04 series equivalent; applies to M1 and N1 only

au-f2006l01392.summary: ADR 18/03 specifies requirements for the provision of speedometers (and odometer equipment) in vehicles. It applies to LC, LD, LE and all M and N category vehicles from 1 July 2006 (new models) and 1 July 2007 (all models); UN Regulation 39 (00, 01 or 02 series) is deemed equivalent.
au-f2006l01392._why: Function/scope cl.1 speedometers; applicability trailers N/A; alternative standards cl.6 UN R39; wiring/infotainment not supported

au-f2006l01410._why: Scope: head restraint design; cl.22.6 deems UN R25 and R17 equivalent

au-f2006l01429._why: Scope: side door strength of passenger cars; only FMVSS 214 alternative, no UN equivalent

au-f2006l01430._why: Scope: requirements for vehicle configuration and dimensions; table covers all categories

au-f2006l01431.summary: ADR 44/02 specifies construction requirements for specific-purpose vehicles: tow trucks, pole-type trailers, LPG-fuelled vehicles, emergency vehicles, motorhomes/caravans and omnibuses. It applies across L, M, N and O categories from dates in its applicability table.
au-f2006l01431._why: Scope clause lists the vehicle types; old summary said text lacked technical requirements, but they are present; table includes L categories

au-f2006l01433.summary: ADR 45/01 specifies photometric requirements for lighting and light-signalling devices not covered by ECE Regulations, to give adequate illumination without undue glare. It includes individual specifications for external cabin lamps, with the circumstances of fitment set in ADR 13.
au-f2006l01433._why: Scope cl.2.1, cl.3.2-3.3, cl.6.1 (old summary ended with '...')

au-f2006l01440._why: Scope: retroreflecting devices; cl.7.1 accepts UN R3 02 series

au-f2006l01442.summary: ADR 48/00 prescribes photometric requirements for devices that illuminate the rear registration plate. Whether such lamps are mandatory, optional or prohibited is set by ADRs 13, 19 or 67; any edition of UN Regulation 4 is accepted as an alternative.
au-f2006l01442._why: Scope cl.1, applicability cl.2.1, alternative standards cl.7.1 UN R4

au-f2006l01450.summary: ADR 58/00 specifies construction requirements for omnibuses designed for, and licensed for, hire and reward, in addition to individual ADRs for omnibuses. It applies to M2 and M3 categories only; UN R52 (01 series) and UN R107 (02-05 series) are deemed equivalent for small omnibuses up to 15 persons.
au-f2006l01450._why: Scope cl.2, applicability table, alternative standards 4.1-4.2 (old summary ended with '...')

au-f2006l01455.summary: ADR 69/00 specifies full frontal crash requirements in terms of forces and accelerations measured on dummies in outboard front seats, to minimise occupant injury. It applies to M1 passenger cars (and some N1); vehicles complying with ADR 73/00 using dual frontal airbags can be deemed compliant.
au-f2006l01455._why: Scope cl.2, applicability table, alternative standards cl.12 (old summary ended with '...')
